pages.title: The Big Rip
pages.text: $(thing)The Big Rip$()$(br2)If dark energy is phantom - w below -1 - its density grows as space expands. Clusters, then galaxies, then stars and planets, then atoms are torn apart, all in a finite time. Unlocks the Phantom Energy Cell.

$(thing)Insight$(): 190$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Eschatology, Mass Manipulation.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Negative Mass Ingot.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Dark energy with equation of state w below −1 grows denser as space expands, so the scale factor reaches infinity at a finite time. In a flat universe of matter fraction Ω_m expanding at H₀ today, the remaining time depends on how far w lies below −1. Write the time left until everything is torn apart.
